description: Met him with the flour still on her arms, and named the letter.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Took the lath, and began on the hilt.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Addressed the horse, and refused him as a customer.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Took the ribbons, and declined a share of the sword.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Said he was thin, and moved the wet away from the bread.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Took the horse, began with the hay, and named the house as ready.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Thanked him, and opened the riddle-book at the stair.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Answered the door, gave the gifts, and kept the speech unsaid.
name: William Shakespeare
